headline: Weather is slowing Newark and Dulles; other hubs are running normally.

items.text: The 160 United flights in the air are 67% fewer than the usual 491 for this time of day, because United schedules far fewer flights for Thanksgiving Day.
Low visibility and rain are slowing Newark, and very low clouds and rain are slowing Washington Dulles.
The other hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better, meaning within 30 minutes of schedule.
